notes.title: Release 1st Anniversary Celebration! Digital Deluxe Bundle Now Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474185/2fd013ab32274fe0b52bb2d123d06b5a56a4117c.png
To commemorate the 1st anniversary since the release of “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth” we are pleased to announce the launch of the “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth - Digital Deluxe Bundle” which includes everything the game has to offer!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474185/3df765ddf0752f2982afdd252aebd3e2be3efea9.png
This bundle includes the main game, “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth -Arabian Nyaights-” along with the "DLC 'Christmas Set' Costume Set" where Persha and Rock don festive Christmas outfits, and a 25-track “Soundtrack” that beautifully captures the world of “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth”.

Moreover, this bundle is available at a constant 32% discount! Even if you already own the main game, you can still purchase the DLC and soundtrack at a discounted price.

Let's enjoy the “Persha and the Magic Labyrinth - Digital Deluxe Bundle”!


＜Bundle Detail＞
・Persha and the Magic Labyrinth -Arabian Nyaights-
・Persha and the Magic Labyrinth - "Christmas set" Costume Set
・Persha and the Magic Labyrinth - Soundtrack


▼Store is here▼
